notes.title: Galcon 2 – Galaxy Map 2.0
notes.content:
The Galaxy Map has been re-opened!  The major changes include dividing the clans into factions and connections between stars.

http://www.galcon.com/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/newsitem2.jpg

The main changes from the old map are: 

- Clans are divided into 3 factions 
- All wars and alliances require proximity 
- The map will supernova after X days 
- Stars values no longer change 

Have fun!
-Phil

notes.title: 1.0.7 - Minor update
notes.content:
Hi, thanks everyone for playing Galcon 2!  It's been great reading your feedback and seeing you play the game!

I've done a minor bug-fix update today:

- Fixed it so German keyboards can type '@' when entering email addresses.
- Fixed it so "Auto-Name" accounts don't have to re-play the tutorial every time they want to sign on.

Thanks again for playing!  Have fun!
-Phil
